verdict.rationale: Nothing in Plaid's first-party docs describes bank-hosted OAuth connections, institution OAuth coverage, or a plan to retire legacy credential flows. The Link doc only describes the client-side linking component. Community reports run the other way: users describe screen-scraping, credentials entered into Plaid's own UI, and broken 2FA at US banks. One comment says Plaid uses PSD2 Open Banking APIs in Europe, but that is undocumented hearsay and does not cover major-institution OAuth coverage.
